summary: Phase 10 (cs5_completeness) unchanged, landed. Phase 11.3 (nik_TS5_consistent, nik_soundness_onePoint) unchanged, landed in the prior dispatch, sorry-free and axiom-clean -- DO NOT re-attempt. Phase 11.1/11.2 (the general nik_TS5_soundness) escalated to [BLOCKED] this (third) dispatch, per the Escalation Protocol -- a change in framing from the prior two dispatches, which treated the gap as a scope/budget continuation. This dispatch attempted to actually close the finite-clique-relift lemma the second dispatch's docstring targeted, on both the (boxI) producer side and the (boxE) consumer side (the latter not examined before: boxE consumes TClosure-derived edges, including .symm-reversed ones on already-fixed, non-fresh labels, needing EXACT symmetry cs5Incest does not supply). Both sides converge on the same root cause: of cs5FCIncest's five conjuncts, only hrefl/htrans have non-existential conclusions -- hfour/hsymbox/hincest are all irreducibly existential (raised-witness), so no chain of them can pin down an exact relational fact between two independently-fixed points, yet CKForces's box clause hands the induction an adversarially-fixed successor u requiring exact interpretation (persistence is only upward). A battery of finite hand-constructed candidate models (Fin n / nat with linear <=) was tried to determine if this is a real obstruction: every attempt satisfying hincest+hfour+hsymbox kept being forced by exact htrans composition back into symmetric/clique closure anyway -- no stable finite asymmetric countermodel was found, but a full proof of the positive claim (cs5FCIncest forces symmetric closure on finitely-generated substructures) was also not completed. This is a genuinely open question, not a missing lemma. No new sorry-free lemma was added toward the general theorem; the finding is recorded in Soundness.lean's docstring ('Third dispatch' section) and a new continuation handoff, with three ranked recommended next steps (none attempted this dispatch, each re-plan/research-pass scale). Phase 12 correctly remains not started.
blockers: Phase 11.1/11.2 (general nik_TS5_soundness): cs5FCIncest's hfour/hsymbox/hincest conjuncts only ever yield existentially-raised relational witnesses, never exact edges between two independently-fixed points. CKForces's box clause hands the induction an adversarially-fixed successor u requiring exact (not raised) interpretation, since CKForces persistence is only upward. boxE additionally needs exact symmetry of r on already-fixed (non-fresh) labels reached via TClosure.symm-derived edges, which cs5Incest's weakened substitute does not supply. Neither a positive nor negative resolution of 'does cs5FCIncest force symmetric/clique closure on finitely-generated substructures' was reached this dispatch. Unblock via one of: (1) resolve that open question and reuse/adapt the landed FLO closure machinery if it resolves positively (cheapest, try first); (2) formalize Simpson's own modified-sequent-system route (L_m(TS5,emptyset), Ch. 8 8.1.2) -- his own stated fix for exactly this problem, re-plan scale; (3) build the deferred Hilbert-labelled equivalence bridge (Ch. 6) and derive labelled soundness as a corollary of the already-proven cs5_soundness_derivable_incest -- reopens a scope decision this plan's Option B deliberately deferred.

dead_ends: Producer-side (boxI) exact-edge derivation: attempted to derive r (rho a) u (or its reverse) exactly, for an adversarially-fixed u and an already-established edge-cond fact r (rho a) (rho x), via hfour/hsymbox/cs5FCIncest_lift composition -- every route produces only an existentially-raised witness (some v >= rho a with r v u), never r (rho a) u exactly. Confirmed by direct instantiation attempts against all three existential clauses.

Consumer-side (boxE) exact-symmetry derivation: attempted to derive r (rho x) (rho y) exactly from r (rho y) (rho x) (the natural one-directional interpretation of a raw addEdge edge) via cs5Incest -- only yields exists u' >= (target), r u' (source), i.e. a raised reversal, not exact symmetry. New finding this dispatch (not examined by the prior two).

Finite countermodel search for cs5FCIncest without exact symmetry: multiple Fin n / nat candidate relations (linear <=, seed edges plus hincest-mandated back-witnesses) were constructed by hand; each one that satisfied hincest+hfour+hsymbox was subsequently forced by exact htrans composition of the newly-required witnesses back into full symmetric/clique closure, collapsing the intended asymmetric example. No stable counterexample found, but the positive claim (cs5FCIncest entails such closure in general) was also not proven -- open question, not a dead end to abandon, but not resolved this dispatch either.
Direct proof attempt of cs5FCIncest r -> r w u -> r u w (general exact symmetry): chained hincest+hfour and hincest+hsymbox in several orders; none closed to an exact (non-existential) conclusion.
